sous_titre: Milliards d'ordonnances délivrées, génériques et biosimilaires contre médicaments de marque, 2024 et 2025

Génériques 2024.texte: Generic prescriptions filled were 3.9 billion prescriptions filled at a cost of $98 billion

Génériques 2025.texte: Generics represent 89% of the prescriptions dispensed (4 billion), they account for only 11.6% of the drug spend

Marque 2024.texte: Brand medicines were 435 million prescriptions filled at a cost of $700 billion

Marque 2025.texte: 4 billion generic prescriptions were filled versus 485 million brand drug prescriptions
